final.sample_inclusion: 3 mice per group, 9 LSK libraries, all deposited
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 6 weeks of voluntary wheel running on the LSK (HSPC) transcriptome: Ex vs Sed
planned_contrasts: Ex vs Sed (S2.3.p3, Fig. 3o-r; Supplementary Table 2, count not stated in text)
ExSed vs Sed (S2.3.p3, Fig. 3o; persistence after wheel withdrawal)

final.deviation_note: The paper states no DEG cutoff for RNA-seq; BH padj < 0.05 without effect-size rule is the workflow default. The audit rule adds |log2FC| > 1 because the paper's ORA (Fig. 3p,q) used >=2-fold downregulated genes; it is a labelled comparison only.
